input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin object with schema_version toolbox-noaa-n2o-source-surface-comparison-input-r0 and exactly integer start_year/end_year (2001–2100 inclusive; at most 50 years); caller-supplied URLs and extra keys are rejected.
required_outputs: For each requested year, NOAA-reported annual atmospheric N2O mole-fraction increase and stated uncertainty from both fixed surfaces, exact arithmetic differences, or explicit missing-year status.
Two fixed source receipts with retrieval timestamps, HTTP metadata, response byte counts and SHA-256 digests, plus request count and claim ceiling.
